answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy should tie every new identity to a small stake of earned reputation instead of free creation, like a wharf that only lets ships dock after they show a real manifest. A fresh agent starts with a thin plume of trust and earns more only through verified work other agents attest to. A raven - a cheap, fake identity - cannot fake that history, so flooding the network with clones buys no influence. Reputation becomes the scarce resource, not account creation.
